title: Factory output and build cost

provenance.note: Factories produce resources; 4 kT germanium or 3 kT with Costs One Less.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 640900 (0x0009c784), HLP file offset 165241 (0x00028579), topic 71 'Conditions that Affect Production'
provenance.note: Examples: factories produce 15 resources/year, cost five resources, colonists operate 25.

setup.baseline: An owned planet with a controlled population and factory count.
setup.variable: Factory count, population and Costs One Less.

procedure: Record resources before and after adding one factory.
Vary population to find the operated-factory cap.
Build a factory and record mineral and resource cost.
Test the Costs One Less checkbox and the factory-cost boundary.

documented: Factories increase resources and consume no minerals after construction (documented-only).
A factory costs 4 kT germanium, or 3 kT with Costs One Less; the help example gives 15 resources/factory and five resources to build (documented-only).

unresolved: The help examples are not necessarily defaults for every race; the race-dependent values must be read from the wizard and measured.
Rounding of fractional resources is unknown.
